project_info.theme: Techcombank OneU Hai Phong food map with U-Point deals
project_info.color_palette: Soft pastel sky, white, black, bright red, green landscape, warm food colors

main_subject.detail: A city food-guide poster with the top-right lockup 'TECHCOMBANK OneU'. The large headline reads 'Kham pha ban do am thuc Hai Phong' with the subline 'An ngon co U-Point chieu dai' and a red button saying 'Kham pha ngay!'. The middle of the poster contains six rounded white restaurant cards arranged in a grid. The venue names are 'Banh Cuon Suon Ha Chi', 'Kicchou Sushi', 'Bun Ca Cay Mo Sim', 'Bun Ca Cay Chu Kho', 'Sua Chua Phuong Ot', and 'Bun Bo Phuong Thao'. The discount amounts are 'Giam 30,000d', 'Giam 30,000d', 'Giam 30,000d', 'Giam 30,000d', 'Giam 15,000d', and 'Giam 15,000d'. The background includes civic architecture, flowering trees, curved green landscape shapes, U-point coins, and a badge reading 'Da tang uu dai LOI ICH TOI UU'.
main_subject.style: Bright discovery-map infographic with restaurant cards, local landmark collage, and approachable social-commerce look
